newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TELINFO REPEATS 96 PROFIT OVER 290 MLN BFR.
newsitem.headline: TELINFO REPEATS 96 PROFIT OVER 290 MLN BFR.

text.p: John Cordier, chairman of Belgian data communications company Telinfo NV, on Thursday reiterated a forecast made in August that his group would earn full-year 1996 pre-tax profit of at least 290 million francs.
"The forecast of 290 million still stands," he told Reuters after a presentation on the VLAM 21 index of leading Flemish bourse-listed companies by Antwerp brokerage Corluy.
In 1995 Telinfo had pre-tax earnings of 276 million francs.
Telinfo has a 10 percent stake in Mobistar, the consortium which operates Belgium's second digital mobile telephone network.
